fields: L5 Shanghai / Dragon Boat Festival (e-bike; Lujiazui → the Bund → Huaihai Road → Xintiandi). Same item fields as L3 v3.1 / L4. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = 端午摊 Zongzi Stall questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12), peak_final = Xintiandi-entrance final (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational). Per run: 3 timed stall in segment 1 + 4 fork in segment 2 + 2 timed stall and 1 Xintiandi final in segment 3 = 10 (one stall pool, drawn as 5 then split 3+2; do not place all 5 timed questions in the first segment). Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Festival riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'), labelled Festival riddle: / 端午谜：. Stems are deduped against all L1–L4 banks (all grades).

questions.q_zh: 一群麻雀原有 2 只，每年变成原来的 3 倍，2 年后有多少只？
questions.qtype_zh: 指数增长/衰减求值（翻倍、等比）

questions.subject: shanghai
questions.q_en: Towers east of the Bund are in ____.
questions.q_zh: 外滩东面的高楼在____。
questions.explain_zh: 那些高楼在浦东陆家嘴。
questions.qtype_zh: 上海地标（陆家嘴/外滩/新天地）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: {name} hangs 2 of 10 different sachets in a row on a stall; order matters. How many arrangements?
questions.q_zh: {name} 从 10 只不同香囊里选 2 只挂成一排，计顺序，有多少种挂法？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A stall-sign curve is f(x) = 3x^3. What is f'(3)?
questions.q_zh: 摊位招牌曲线是 f(x) = 3x^3，f'(3) 是多少？

questions.subject: language
questions.q_en: 乘风破浪 pictures a boat ____.
questions.q_zh: 「乘风破浪」形容船____。
questions.explain_en: It means pushing through wind and waves.

questions.subject: shanghai
questions.q_en: Flora's e-bike ride ends at Xintiandi. Which description of that place is right?
questions.q_zh: Flora 的电动车骑到新天地就结束了。下面哪一句说对了这个地方？
choices: A fishing village with no streets
A desert camp with no buildings
A high mountain pass above the clouds
Old shikumen fronts with modern shops inside
choices_zh: 一个没有房子的沙漠营地
旧石库门门面，里面是现代店铺
questions.explain_en: Xintiandi kept shikumen street faces and filled them with modern shops.
questions.explain_zh: 新天地保留了石库门门面，里面则是现代店铺。
questions.qtype_zh: 上海生活（梧桐/黄浦江/石库门）

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: On the Bund's wet stones, Flora brakes her e-bike and notices she needs more room to stop than on dry Huaihai Road. The main reason is ____.
questions.q_zh: 外滩石板是湿的，Flora 骑电动车刹车时发现，要比在干的淮海路上留出更长的距离才能停住。主要原因是____。
choices: wet stone makes the motor stronger
the doorman is pulling the bike forward
plane trees add extra mass to the bike
lower friction on the wet surface
choices_zh: 湿石头会让电机更有力
梧桐会给车子加上额外的质量
潮湿地面上的摩擦更小
questions.explain_en: Water reduces friction between the tyres and the stones.
questions.explain_zh: 水会减小轮胎和石板之间的摩擦。
questions.qtype_zh: 力与运动（摩擦/阻力/牛顿定律）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A bunting curve over the Bund is h(x) = 2x^4. What is its slope h'(-3)?
questions.q_zh: 外滩一串彩旗的曲线是 h(x) = 2x^4，它在 x = -3 处的斜率 h'(-3) 是多少？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Zongzi at Xintiandi are set out at a rate of r(t) = 6t zongzi per minute for 0 ≤ t ≤ 2. How many zongzi are set out in total?
questions.q_zh: 新天地的粽子按 r(t) = 6t 只/分钟的速率摆出，0 ≤ t ≤ 2，一共摆出多少只？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At Xintiandi, Flora may pick 4 of 11 different zongzi to share. Order does not matter. How many different sets can she pick?
questions.q_zh: 在新天地，Flora 可以从 11 只不同的粽子里挑 4 只分享，不计顺序，有多少种挑法？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the Bund, Flora guesses 4 stall questions, each with a 1/2 chance of being right, independently. What is the probability she gets exactly 1 right?
questions.q_zh: 在外滩，Flora 猜 4 道摊位题，每道猜对的概率都是 1/2，互不影响。恰好猜对 1 道的概率是多少？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: The Bund's flag rows hold 10, 14, 18 flags and so on, 13 rows in all. How many flags are there in total?
questions.q_zh: 外滩彩旗一排比一排多：10、14、18，依此类推，一共 13 排，总共多少面？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Zongzi at Xintiandi are set out in rounds: 4 zongzi in the first round, then 2 times as many each round, for 4 rounds. How many zongzi in total?
questions.q_zh: 新天地的粽子分轮摆：第一轮 4 只，之后每轮是上一轮的 2 倍，共 4 轮，一共多少只？
